data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $16.5m (2019: $3.7m). Specialty Lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $8.2m and $1.5m respectively. Both specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases. Action taken in the marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the closing of the UK marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $1.9m in the division. Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2020 the syndicate recorded net prior-year reserve releases of $16.5m (approximately -2.0% of opening gross claims outstanding of $821.8m). Releases were concentrated in Specialty Lines and Cyber & Executive Risk, and marine remediation (including closure of the UK marine portfolio) contributed to releases. The Property and Reinsurance divisions also benefitted from favourable development on some 2019 natural catastrophe events (Storm Dorian, Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai). The $16.5m figure is reported in the managing agent narrative (net of reinsurance) and a gross movement breakdown by division is not provided in gross terms in the note, so the gross prior-year movement is not directly stated.

Action taken in the marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the closing of the UK marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $1.9m in the division.
Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan.
The contingency book was most severely impacted as cancelled events were the main driver of the syndicate losses

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding (821.8) taken directly from Balance Sheet (gross). Prior year development figure used is the $16.5m release quoted in the managing agent narrative - this figure is presented net of reinsurance in the narrative and the report does not provide a single explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure. Where the narrative provided division breakdowns these were net of reinsurance; gross PYD was not available, so NET figure used as fallback and flagged here. LOB mapping for some divisions (e.g. Political, Accident & Contingency -> Accident & Health; Specialty Lines -> Professional Lines; Reinsurance -> Treaty) is approximate for standardization.
